example.title: Commercial block at Water & Washington Streets (Decorah Commercial Historic District)

brief: Three-storey Italianate/Queen Anne corner block in red brick: a two-storey galvanized-metal corner oriel (canted bay with paneled aprons and a fish-scale base) hangs over a clipped corner entrance, round-arched upper windows with stone keystones and sills, and a boxed metal cornice with small urn finials at the corners. The ground floor has cast-iron piers and big plate-glass shop windows on a brick bulkhead; an iron fire escape on the side street.

storefronts.sign: AASE JEWELRY - CLASS RINGS - WATCH REPAIR
